nodes.name: Hydrothermal synthesis of NiWO4/NF
nodes.procedure: The NiWO4 nanospheres were grown on NF by a hydrothermal reaction in 70 ml deionized water containing Ni(NO3)2·6H2O (20 mmol), (NH4)6H2W12O40·xH2O (5/12 mmol), and CO(NH2)2 (10 mmol) at 150 °C for 12 h.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni 2p peaks at 855.8, 873.7 eV (Ni²⁺ with satellites at 861.7, 879.6 eV) and 852.6, 869.5 eV (Ni⁰); W 4f peaks at 34.8, 36.9 eV (W⁶⁺) and 30.8, 33.0 eV (W⁰); O 1s shows surface adsorbed and lattice oxygen with reduced surface adsorbed oxygen after annealing; binding energies shift lower after phase transformation from NiWO₄.
nodes.evidence_snippet: For Ni 2p (Fig. 2b), the peaks located at 855.8 and 873.7 eV, accompanied by the satellite peaks at 861.7 and 879.6 eV, are ascribed to Ni²⁺. In addition, the appearance of peaks at 852.6 and 869.5 eV confirms the existence of Ni⁰ derived from the Ni₄W. For W 4f (Fig. 2c), the positions at 34.8 and 36.9 eV belong to W⁶⁺. The peaks of W⁰ are observed at 30.8 and 33.0 eV ... The O 1s region spectrum exhibits two peaks assigned to surface adsorbed and lattice oxygen, and the reductive annealing lowers the intensity of surface adsorbed oxygen ... During the phase transformation from NiWO₄ to Ni₄W/WO₃, the binding energy (BE) of Ni and W shifts toward lower energy.

properties.description: Cyclic voltammetry cycles applied before second measurement

nodes.characterization_summary: Electrochemical double-layer capacitance Cdl = 21.62 mF·cm⁻² for Ni₄W/WO₃/NF and 6.82 mF·cm⁻² for NiWO₄/NF; ECSA of Ni₄W/WO₃/NF is 3.17 times higher than NiWO₄/NF; TOF = 0.38 s⁻¹ at 100 mV overpotential for Ni₄W/WO₃/NF.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Also, the Ni₄W/WO₃/NF has the highest electrochemical double-layer capacitance (Cdl, 21.62 mF·cm⁻²) compared with NiWO₄/NF (6.82 mF·cm⁻²) and NF (0.54 mF·cm⁻²) (Fig. 3d). ... It was found that the ECSA of Ni₄W/WO₃/NF is 3.17 times higher than that of NiWO₄/NF. ... The TOF of Ni₄W/WO₃/NF was 0.38 s⁻¹ at the overpotential of 100 mV.

nodes.characterization_summary: Charge transfer resistance of Ni₄W/WO₃/NF is 3.8 Ω.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The charge transfer resistance of Ni₄W/WO₃/NF is 3.8 Ω, slightly larger than that of Pt/C (~2.1 Ω), less than that of NiWO₄/NF (~6.2 Ω) and NF (~8.3 Ω).

nodes.characterization_summary: 5th harmonic components show remarkably low onset potential of -2 mV for Ni₄W/WO₃/NF, approximate to Pt/C/NF (0 mV).
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 3b shows the 5th harmonic components of the FTacV obtained on Pt/C/NF, Ni₄W/WO₃/NF ... The Ni₄W/WO₃/NF shows a remarkably low onset potential of -2 mV, which is approximate to the Pt/C/NF (0 mV).
